bugs.goal: Preserve valid client-viewer association and role-scoped access during account edits.
bugs.description: The executed isolated mock service tests show client-role edits accept null or nonexistent client references. Validate the merged resulting account before mutation, retain state on failure, and prevent role transitions carrying stale access grants. This is a locally staged genuine bug, not an external GitHub issue.
acceptance_criteria: Client role requires an existing clientId after every create/update, including role-only updates.
Invalid merged account updates reject without modifying the stored account.
When changing a marketer to a different role, clientIds is cleared; non-client roles have clientId null.
Transitioning to marketer starts with no former role client association; explicit admin assignment is required.
Run QA reproduction cases and role-transition regression cases, then relevant full frontend suite.
bugs.out_of_scope: OAuth provider behavior, backend implementation and new account invitation features.
bugs.constraints: Follow ServiceError validation conventions, admin-only mutation, self-account protections, approved client access boundaries; no production auth bypass. Preserve IDs/email/name/enabled unless explicitly edited.
bugs.fix_evidence: Frontend engineer added merged-user validation and role-specific association cleanup; QA executed final build exit 0.
